The 1960–61 [[Primeira Liga|Primeira Divisão]] was the 27th season of [[Portuguese football league system|top-tier]] [[association football|football]] in Portugal.<ref name="soccer library">{{cite web |url=http://soccerlibrary.free.fr/por_ft.pdf|title= Portugal - Table of Honor - soccer library |work=soccer library |access-date=2012-04-20}}</ref>

==Overview==
The competition was contested by 14 teams with [[S.L. Benfica]] winning the 1960–61 [[Primeira Divisão]] championship. It was the eleventh championship title for the club. Benfica also won the [[1961–62 European Cup]] and qualified for the [[1961–62 European Cup|1961–62 competition]]. This enabled second placed [[Sporting CP]] to also qualify for the [[1961–62 European Cup|European Cup]]. [[Leixões S.C.]] qualified for the [[1961–62 European Cup Winners' Cup|Cup Winners' Cup]] and [[C.F. Os Belenenses]] for the [[1961–62 Inter-Cities Fairs Cup|Inter-Cities Fairs Cup]]. The two lowest placed teams of the competition, [[S.C. Braga]] and [[F.C. Barreirense]] were relegated to the [[Segunda Divisão]].<ref name="RSSSF"/>{{citation needed|date=May 2026}}
